ui.title: GRAVSHIFT
ui.upgrade_hint: Left and right then Space, keys 1 2 3 or click
ui.end_hint: Space: play again     Esc: title screen

gameplay.tagline: Your ship is a gravity well.
gameplay.rule_well: Hold Space: the well pulls in the orange bullets and puts them in orbit.
gameplay.rule_sling: Release: the orbiting bullets fly back at the enemies.
gameplay.rule_crash: The well pulls enemies too: thrown into each other, they break.
gameplay.rule_heavy: Spiked red orbs escape gravity: dodge them.
gameplay.controls: Move: arrows or WASD     Well: Space, J or Shift, held     Pause: Esc

feedback.twist_tip: Bullet captured: release to send it back

upgrades.desc_horizon: The well pulls and captures 20% further.
upgrades.desc_sling: Bullets sent back deal 40% more damage.
upgrades.desc_twin: One more automatic shot, +15% fire rate.
upgrades.desc_shrapnel: Bullets sent back burst on impact and hit the neighbours.
upgrades.desc_pierce: Bullets sent back go through one more enemy.
upgrades.desc_grinder: Orbiting bullets no longer wear out when they hit.
upgrades.desc_recoil: The release wave reaches 60% further and stuns.
